persistence_invariants.brief: Composite unique key on (sku, location) so no two stored rows share the pair; a repeat filing collides and updates rather than duplicating.
sku, location, quantity, and inventory_code are NOT NULL; a filing missing any core field is rejected at write time.
CHECK quantity >= 0 so a stored stock level can never go negative (backs R2 at the schema level).
The Alembic migration that creates stock_records has a working downgrade and preserves records created before it (backs R1: no data loss across additive migrations).

nfrs.brief: Existing stock data survives every additive schema migration with no loss; each inventory adjustment keeps an unmodifiable timestamp and actor. Defended by a reversible-migration fitness test (PI4) run against the paired branch.

Stock levels never go below zero and never overcommit beyond available quantity; an overcommitting write is rejected at write time. Enforced by the service (business rule) plus schema CHECK (PI3). For S1 the filing path enforces quantity >= 0.

Every (sku, location) is uniquely addressable; a collision is resolved at write time as an update, never two stored duplicates and never an error page. Defended by the composite-unique constraint PI1 and the service upsert-on-collision logic.

Integration tests run against the paired Lakebase branch (databricks_postgres), never a mock or in-memory substitute; CI refuses to merge a PR whose integration tests do not run against a real branch. Alembic migrations are applied to the branch first, with FK-aware targeted-DELETE cleanup.

The UI is a React + TypeScript single-page app under client/ that navigates client-side with no full-page reloads; the backend boundary returns JSON, not server-rendered HTML (boundary renders_via react). The client ships its own component tests; the API is covered by the branch integration suite (R4).
Preference (nfrs.md): validation messages name the offending field rather than a generic 'bad request'. The boundary returns a structured field-level error the SPA can surface next to the input.

The app connects to the substrate-provisioned databricks_postgres via DATABASE_URL from the paired branch; the database name is not renamed and not made a requirement. Config-in-env fitness test guards DATABASE_URL sourcing.
